D010_m001.question:
I’ve been off the rails for about two months now—can’t sleep, don’t want to sleep. My mind’s racing all the time, like it’s wired. I talk so fast people keep telling me to slow down, but I can’t—it feels like if I stop, I’ll lose something huge. I’ve been pacing my room nonstop, can’t sit still, even tried studying for my exam but ended up scribbling ideas all over the walls. I know it sounds crazy, but I *know* I’m meant for something bigger—like I’m receiving secret messages through smells, like roses and burnt paper that no one else can smell. I’m supposed to lead people, I can feel it.

And there was this guy I met online—hooked up with him three times in a week, even told him I was going to run the country one day. Totally out of character. Now I can’t face him.  

Before this, though, for nearly half a year, I couldn’t get out of bed. Felt nothing—no joy, no sadness, just hollow. Stopped answering calls, couldn’t pick what to wear, even what to eat. Everything felt impossible. Right now, I’m crashing again, but these past weeks… I wasn’t just “feeling good.” I was *activated*, like I had a mission. But I’m scared—what if I lose myself again?
D010_m001.options:

    B. Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)
    C. Bipolar I Disorder
    D. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
D010_m001.answer: D. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
